messages:
anya: intake for Gamma - they want a concise PRD for tenant-scoped rollouts when switching to quantized/optimized model variants. main concerns: visible regressions and unpredictable latency.
anya: quick problem: some tenants see degraded completions after we flip model variants. customer requests a formal acceptance gate + automated rollback.
anya: high-level goals: (a) explicit acceptance metrics + sampling cadence, (b) automated canary controller + emergency kill-switch, (c) Console visibility per-tenant (eval diffs, top failing prompts, latency breakdown), (d) runbook for on-call.
anya: explicit non-goals: changing global autoscaling, training model fixes, or expanding to multi-tenant eval orchestration v1. keep scope to rollout controls + observability.
carlos: for acceptance metrics: propose p95 latency, prompt-eval score delta, and a lightweight hallucination heuristic. define sampling cadence and sample size.
sophia: Console needs a clear 4-step visual: canary -> ramp -> stabilize -> rollback. show recent eval delta and quick link to prompt examples.
ben: storage question: where should customers upload their eval prompt sets? allow both managed upload and customer S3. managed is easier for quick onboarding but we need export + retention policy.
carlos: recommend managed eval bundles now. API: POST /evals {name, prompts[], ground_truth[]} with versioning. user can export manifest.
anya: draft acceptance thresholds (initial):
```
- p95 request latency <= 275ms during canary window (end-to-end)
- quality delta <= 2.5% relative to baseline on tenant eval set
- hallucination rate increase <= 0.7% measured by rule-based checks
- canary duration: min 20m, max 24h unless manual extend
- rollback if any threshold breached for 3 consecutive sampling intervals
```
mike: define sampling interval and "consecutive" semantics. suggest 6-minute intervals -> 3 intervals = 18 minutes continuous breach before auto-rollback.
carlos: note: hallucination detector should be fast: regex + embedding similarity to ground truth. start with cheap heuristics; iterate.
sophia: edge case: tiny customer eval sets. policy: require >=20 prompts for auto-rollout. if <20, surface low-confidence flag and require manual approval.
anya: agreed. fallback: use product-wide benchmark with a confidence downgrade if tenant set too small.
ben: suggested rollout sequence: 5% traffic for 30m -> 25% for 90m -> 100% (or manual). add instant kill-switch to revert traffic.
mike: can we route to a pinned hosted variant automatically on rollback to minimize customer downtime? yes if tokenization/config is compatible. need compatibility checks.
carlos: runtime note: traffic-controller must support per-tenant routing rules+ fast reconfiguration. implement atomic switch to avoid partial states.
anya: success metrics for the initiative:
- decrease customer post-rollout regression reports by 85% within 3 months
- median recovery time after automated rollback < 10 minutes
- >=75% of pilot customers can self-serve rollouts within 48 hours of docs release

anya: PRD checklist (owners):
- accept-metric spec (eng-data)
- runtime canary controller + kill-switch (eng-runtime)
- Console flows + mocks (design/frontend)
- eval upload API + storage + export (prod-ops)
- rollback runbook & SLOs (SRE)

sophia: I'll post Console mockups by Tue afternoon.
carlos: I'll draft a tech spec for runtime by Friday.
ben: I'll get Gamma's sample prompts and confirm their desired rollout cadence.
mike: @deploy-bot can you reserve a staging window for an E2E test?
deploy-bot: scheduled staging window 2024-11-09T09:00Z for 2h. reminder 30m prior. :white_check_mark:
anya: quick sync Friday 11am to lock acceptance numbers and owners. aim to finish PRD this sprint. objections?
carlos: none.
sophia: good.
ben: ok.
mike: fine.
anya: thanks everyone. I'll draft the PRD and drop in #product for review.
